5005.synopsis:
Hao Ren (literally means “good man”), as his Chinese name suggested, is a good man, and his ideal was to live a restful, comfortable life as a landlord. At least that was his plan before a couple of abnormal creatures rented his house.
A remote, outdated big apartment, a bunch of rather abnormal non-human creatures, and a labor contract from the “god”, the three factors combined lead him to be the busiest landlord and most supernatural “babysitter”. The story of the most complicated, erratic and abnormal landlord and tenants started from here.
“Ever since I put my fingerprint on the labor contract, I knew I was roped into something terrible…”
As a person who is down-to-earth as well as a good Samaritan, Hao Ren desires to live the rest of his life as a benevolent landlord. Stumbling into a curious yet mysterious lady, he began his journey of “collecting” abnormal and supernatural tenants.
His life only became more chaotic when he receives a labor contract from “God”. Discover the many races, myths and worlds that lie beyond what humans define as normal! This bizarre fantasy full of fun is sure to bring you on a crazy rollercoaster of emotions!

5517.synopsis:
The greatest trial for love is time. The ultimate test for any relationship is whether or not time can change the feelings of a person. Honey, Let’s Go! enables us to view a different angle of love, its power and its limits.
The story told the tale of Qiao-er and a strange vampire. Sleeping next to such a horrifying being everyday, what happen if she falls in love with it?
All she can think about is him, about the short lifespan of humans and the immortality of vampires. The girl is not very bright, and her thoughts have always been slow. The vampire have been cultivating for a thousand years. Where is the end for their romance? Could there really exist a path of escape for the both of them? 
Honey, Let’s Go is the tale of love between worlds. Could they stay together forever more or will they be forced apart, doomed to eternally search for each other from one life to the next?

5773.synopsis:

But either by luck or fate, after suffering a hit in the head, Evan started having dreams of a place with extremely high-technology beyond anything he could imagine, on it he saw dolls being controlled by some strange magic and glowing windows with moving pictures. This dreams leads him to develop a new magic he calls control magic, that does not belong to any of the known elements. Now Evan with his new abilities goes adventuring with his maid Serafina.

When he was only a child Shi Ying’s mother was framed, and he was banished to Jiuyi Mountain to cultivate. During his teenage years Shi Ying meets Zhu Yan and takes her as his disciple. With the time Shi Ying began to develop romantic feelings for Zhu Yan. However because of their relationship as teacher and student, both of them do not voice out their feelings.

12941.synopsis:
The archaeologist “red-haired witch” made too big of a disturbance while excavating tombs, gloriously becoming a martyr in the midst of the grave chamber’s collapse. Seventeen years later, she had transmigrated into the Five Regions Continent. The delinquent Meng Fuyao who struggled to survive in the lowest rungs of society, cast aside her boyfriend who was about to marry another person with a slice of his five fingers. 
“Believe me, she will be an absolutely perfect wife. With her by your side, you will be like an aristocrat and her luxury poodle – no matter where you go, your status will increase by a hundred-fold and complement each other perfectly.” 
Forsaken love, abandoned like dog shit. From then on it was a boundless sky and open sea, a trek of ten thousand li. To obtain the Seven States seals, fight against the world first. For the hope of return in her heart, brazenly collide with the Machiavellian royalty of the seven states, uniting the outstanding and talented under the heavens through fortuitous meetings. 
And so, will this road of chanced affection go through the peak of heavenly mountains and the warmth of bonfires; the glint of sword shadows and the coldness of the glance backwards; the autumn sun’s golden wind and the flying sweep of the robe sleeve; or that chilly moonlit forest and that sprint like an arrow’s? 13453.synopsis:
In the Great Orient, lies the continent called Rodenius.
One day, an unidentified flying object arrived at Qua-Toyne Principality’s airspace. The unidentified flying object defied the Principality’s common sense. But that unidentified flying object was just a harbinger of something even more shocking.
Far to the eastern sea, a group of islands suddenly appeared. The country of the islands called itself: Japan. According to them, their nation had been transported to another world.
Now finding themselves separated from their old world and must survive in the new one, how will Japan interact with the native countries of this world? Will they greet her as a friend or as an enemy?
This is a story of the country called Japan as it was engulfed in the chaotic storm of the world.

22157.synopsis:
It’s hard to be beautiful
Every move you make; people will look at you.
When you make a mistake; all eyes are on you.

Eya is a kind-hearted girl who has faced several difficulties in life. Orphaned at the age of 14, her aunt adopts her but kicks her out as soon as she turns 18. Unable to make ends meet, she gets a new job as a nanny only to realize she has to look after Cross, an egoistic young man whom she calls the “monster”. Cross, having lost his mother at a young age, has grown resentful towards everybody around him. But regardless of their differences, they start to get along well.
Eya does not realize that she is caught up in a twisted, complicated love square (?). She starts developing a crush on her best friend Chad, who likes her friend Lory. However, Lory has had a crush on Cross since they were in kindergarten… How will this all pan out for Eya?

22925.synopsis: After the mistake of charm and romance of one night, he couldn’t stop missing her body, and since then he wanted to merge with her nonstop day and night. Yet he said, “Abort it.” She turned her back with a smile, knowing that he loved that woman so much that he could be so cruel to the mother of his baby…… When she disappeared, he suddenly realized that she had been marked deep in his body and became the love of his life!

25229.synopsis:

Chika was able to stay patient with everything else, but she was annoyed from the bottom of her heart with the new hobby that her mother started.
Fumie operated the PC awkwardly, and wrote a light novel using the plot that Takashi left behind. It was a fantasy novel about Takashi being reincarnated in a different world, and used the knowledge of the present world to make weapons and stood against the demon lord.

25997.synopsis:
Chen Lan, 36, has a 16-year-old face. Everyone who knows his real age is stunned. His boyfriend calls him the Ageless Seducer. The Ageless Seducer is a cheeky, good looking fighter, the white in the waves. He seems coquettish, but is, in fact, conservative. He only loves his boyfriend, Li PanEn. Chen Lan, the Ageless Seducer, is a bartender in a bar and likes to make everyone believe that he is weak. Every time he comes back with a wound, Li PanEn is usually angry and distressed. The Ageless Seducer has to exert his demonic power, grind hard and soft so that he can make every effort to seduce his family’s Xiao PanEn, and successfully turn the contradiction into something not invisible.
Li PanEn met Chen Lan when he was 18 years old. Since then, his heart has been tied to Chen Lan, and he never left. He broke off his relationship with his family and went abroad to study (with Chen Lan). His childish, middle-aged, and violent temper gradually flattened Chen Lan’s edges, and he successfully captured himself a little loyal dog.

26509.synopsis:
Feng Xi, a scholar, also a thief master by avocation. His life goal was stealing things all over the world. Even after he was dead, he still couldn’t rest in peace. As a result, one of his theft caused a great war between Gods and demons… After knowing about the truth, King of the Netherworld gazed at his sweetheart who seemed to feel so guilty, or was only tittering, for a long while…
Feng Xi, with his head lowered, admitted his fault in earnest, “Sorry, it’s my fault!”
After a brief pause, King of the Netherworld said, “Next time, don’t forget to bring me!”
Feng Xi raised his head with puzzle while staring at the king with his two clear eyes.
The king, as calm as the look on his face was, added, “I’ll clean up the mess for you!”
Feng Xi was in a daze for a long while. Then he nodded vigorously like chickens pecking on grain.

31629.synopsis:
If there is no “Beauty” in “The Beauty and the Beast”, then who shall lift the Beast’s curse?
“One day, someone trapped in a world of black and white will appear, and stain your world with blood.”
Thanks to this prophecy, the “Beast”, Prince Reynsis, was abandoned and left to fend for himself. To undo the curse, he needs the “Beauty”, but the only problem is–

39053.synopsis:
The flower demon, Shao Zi, understands how to be grateful. She was taken in by the old innkeeper of the tavern, so she must spend the rest of her life guarding the tavern.

The most precious sentiments she’s ever experienced in the world came from these guests. By experiencing their pains along with their joys, she tasted an emotional satisfaction that she has never had in these five hundred years of life.
However, helping others always comes at a price. When she wavered over the notion of extending a helping hand for the sake of protecting the tavern from destruction, someone stood firmly by her side.

Song Yaoyao had already died in her previous life. Her life ended on the day of her 19th birthday. Cause of death: heart failure.

46989.synopsis:
*Celeb: short for celebrity.

180 degrees change.

47501.synopsis:
Tao Ti, a little taotie* cub, transmigrated and became the bride of the sickly crown prince who was meant to chase out his ill fortune, but ended up committing su*cide by ingesting poison. 
Met by the disgusted gazes of everyone in the Eastern Palace, Tao Ti was a little flustered.
Just then, the crown prince who was rumoured to soon die from illness comforted her, “Don’t be scared, I’ll give you a letter of annulment before I die, and return you your freedom.”
Tao Ti was stunned, “A-alright.”
Inwardly, she thought, “A gentle and beautiful man; I’m fine with this!!!”
Later——
When the crown prince was ridiculed, Tao Ti rolled up her sleeves to defend him.
When the crown prince was sick with a high fever, Tao Ti boiled the medicine herself.
When the crown prince’s appetite was poor, Tao Ti cooked, fried, steamed, and baked. 
Everyone in the Eastern Palace: Safeguard the best crown princess in the world!
~
The prince of the outlying tribe was muscular and bold; he planned to abduct Taoti to the grasslands once the crown prince died.
The crown prince broke the prince’s leg, then, in the middle of the night, blocked Tao Ti.
Tao Ti’s voice trembled, “Your… Your Highness?”
The crown prince’s eyes were dark, and his smile was warm. “If I had known that you liked wild ones, I would’ve stopped pretending.”
*T/N: Taotie are ancient Chinese mythological creatures with an insatiable appetite, commonly emblazoned on bronze vessels. It’s now used as a term to describe gluttonous people. Written as 饕餮, it’s pronounced ‘Tao Ti’ in Chinese, which happens to be a homonym of the FL’s name, 陶缇 (Tao Ti).

48525.synopsis:
My childhood friend, Aoi Tsukishiro, is unsociable, but her cool good looks make her stand out.

A relationship that started as friends turned into happiness.
I, who distrusts women, and she, who is a kuudere. A coming-of-age novel about the spring, summer, fall, and winter of two people living together.

54413.synopsis:
I’m a demon! A NEET demon who lives off of his two outstanding brothers!

55949.synopsis:

“I’ve never been able to figure out what our relationship really is.”

Reuniting as old friends and becoming friends with benefits, and then unexpectedly falling in love. A doctor as the dominant partner and an painter/artist as the submissive.
Love is a wonderful thing, even when you’re in your thirties, it’s not a loss.

59533.synopsis:
Every trace of my entire youth is engraved with the same name.

I have said goodbye to him countless times, on the phone, on WeChat, face to face, every time without pressure, because I know there will be another meeting.
But this time is different, Xu Jiamu, this time I really want to say goodbye to you.

Ling Ye transmigrated to a Xuanhuan novel world. As a hidden expert, he kept a low profile throughout the book.

If only I was Yoon Hye-an in reality rather than Choi Hong-seo as I thought I was.
It shouldn’t hurt this much to see him treat me so coldly.
This feeling and this pain couldn’t be fake.

When the eldest prince Luo Fei reached 18 years old, the database automatically screened the genes of omegas across the entire empire for matching. 72589.synopsis:

Xiao Yihan patted the spot next to him on the bed and said with a serious little adult-like expression: “Here. After all, I’m going to marry you sooner or later. Don’t worry, I’ll take responsibility!”
Jiang Wei: “……”
What kind of responsibility could a little kid who only plays in the mud take?
A story with a bit of sweetness about a cold, aloof dance major girl versus a mischievous medical school heartthrob guy.

76941.synopsis:
Mishima Kanji is just an ordinary high school student who likes games and giant robots. 
The new VRMMO “HAO” takes place in a sci-fi world and boasted overwhelming combat freedom – you could shoot guns, enhance your body and swing blades, use psychic abilities, or avoid combat entirely and profit massively from item production.

After spending all his starting skill points, all he had to show for it was an immobile junk robot and two thick engineering textbooks in English he’d never read. After the deed, the Empress quietly left. Just when he thought he would never see her again, she showed up in front of him ten years later, bringing a child, saying it was his daughter and demanding accountability from him!

This time, I will achieve complete rest.

The war demon duke, who has slaughtered thousands of monsters, clings me, claiming he doesn’t want to lose me.

The holy land of the Demonic Path, the ten Demonic Sects. 
When they combined their strength, the world came to call them Demon Palace.
And now, in the holy land of all the world’s demons, a Heavenly Demon awakens, ready to devour the martial world.

88717.synopsis:
Li Shuang, the adopted daughter of the Grand General, guards the borders of Da Jin. One day, she discovers an amnesiac Ao Deng, the Crown Prince of the Western Regions, who has been cursed and transformed into a child by dark magic. She names him Jin’an. 
By day, Jin’an appears as a child, but at night, he transforms into a masked warrior known as the Black-Faced Armored Man, repeatedly aiding Li Shuang in repelling the armies of the Western Regions.
On a cold winter night, amidst wind and snow on the mountaintop, a single kiss stirs Li Shuang’s emotions. For him, she forsakes her freedom and journeys to Mount Nanchang. For her, he leaves his homeland and abandons wealth and glory.
Together, they endure numerous hardships, until finally, hand in hand, they retreat into seclusion in the mountains and forests.

89229.synopsis:
Pei Chen, the top student and school heartthrob at Lincheng No. 1 High School, has pale skin and cold eyes. He is introverted and indifferent to the extreme, coming from a poor family. Aside from his studies, nothing else catches his attention.
On the other hand, Liang Zhiyi, who comes from a distinguished family and is the epitome of beauty and pride, is completely different. With her black hair and red lips, she is bright and bold. From the moment she arrived at the school, she passionately pursued Pei Chen.
However, Pei Chen remained unmoved, cold as ice. Everyone privately praised his integrity, saying that no matter how hard she tried, she couldn’t win him over.
Upon hearing this, Liang Zhiyi rested her chin in her palm, her eyebrows arched in a smile: “He’ll only like me.”
—
One day, a wealthy young man suddenly appeared by Liang Zhiyi’s side, sparking rumors at school that they were a perfect match.
On the night after the college entrance exam, Liang Zhiyi and Pei Chen walked through a deserted alley. The girl hooked her finger around the boy’s coat hem, a mischievous smile on her face: “Today, He Ming confessed to me. If you don’t like me, I’ll go out with him.”
The boy’s jaw tightened, his eyes lowered, and he said nothing.
Thinking he was as indifferent as usual, the girl was about to turn away when her wrist was suddenly grasped, and a light kiss landed at the corner of her lips.
Pei Chen looked at her, his dark eyes burning, his voice restrained and earnest: “Can you not say yes to him?”
—
Later, Pei Chen became a tech tycoon worth billions and gave Liang Zhiyi an incredibly romantic and grand wedding.
After the wedding, she accidentally found an old diary of his, the handwriting blurred:
“If I were from a wealthy family, I would have kissed her without restraint, pried open her lips, and lost myself in her completely.”
·
The indifference he showed back then wasn’t because he wasn’t moved, but because you were high above, and I was low and humble.
【A gorgeous, bold heiress who knows how to flirt】&【A seemingly cold, but actually pure-hearted and easily flustered boy with deep feelings】
【Mini Scene】
Pei Chen is famously aloof.
After Liang Zhiyi got together with him, her friend worried for her, “That bookworm of yours, if you two are lying down together, will he just talk to you about calculus or advanced math?”
“…”
At first, Liang Zhiyi thought so too, but later that night, when he pinned her down, Pei Chen propped himself up, his breath brushing against her face, his gaze intense, and in a low voice, he asked, “Do you like me, hmm?”
It was only then she discovered that beneath his cold exterior, there was a youthful, impulsive passion, with an explosive aura of hormones, the contrast making him extremely sexy.
In the end, she sniffled and called him a “rogue…”
Pei Chen responded softly, kissing her earlobe, “Mm, only you know.”
【Story Tips】:
※ This is a Mary Sue story, but it’s super sweet! So sweet! The girl chases the boy, but the girl is not mistreated! The heroine has the hero’s heart firmly in her grasp from the beginning. :o3
※ The male lead is poor at the start, but he’ll improve later.

90509.synopsis:
Top: Woo In-hyeok (37): Director of Daeheung Construction. Originally a loyal dog of the organization’s boss, he became a cruel stray dog after losing Lee Do-geom and regressing three years into the past. Though he appears cold-blooded, he is a man who would sacrifice even his heart for Lee Do-geom.
Bottom: Lee Do-geom (22): An unfortunate college student who has lost his parents, foster parents, and even his brother. He possesses the ability to “solve any code” and is referred to as “Clé” by those in the shadows. He quickly opens his heart to Woo In-hyeok, who knows too much about him, and is drawn to vow revenge for his family, as intended by Woo In-hyeok.
When to Read This: When you want to see the incident story of a regretful top who is ready to give everything for the bottom and a beautiful innocent bottom who gradually falls for him.
Relatable Quote: “I guarantee that nothing I give you will harm you in any way.”
Lee Do-geom, who has lost his entire family, is on the brink of being sold off to loan sharks. Thanks to Woo In-hyeok, the director of Daeheung Construction, who appears as if he had been waiting, he narrowly escapes the crisis. However, this man knows far too much about him—creepily so. To make matters worse, he begins to act as if he would give anything with his cold demeanor.
“Just accept anything I give you without discrimination.”
“I guarantee that nothing I give you will harm you in any way.”
“So, what do you say? Shall we make a deal?”
Meanwhile, Lee Do-geom discovers that those who mu*dered his family under the guise of an accident are coveting his “ability”…
“I really need you, Uncle.”
“Please give you to me, Uncle.”
“You say some intriguing things.”
“I’ve been yours from the very beginning.”

91021.synopsis:
“Can you, Otaku-kun, conquer the ‘front (me)’ with the guidance of the ‘back (me)’?”
Tsuchiya Bunta, an ordinary high school student, finds his small happiness in catching a glimpse of Omotekawa Yui, a girl from another school, during his morning commute to school. Secretly, Bunta calls her the “Saint,” and her graceful presence soothes his heart. However, the one who starts talking to him isn’t the Saint, but a gal who looks the complete opposite!?
The gal who introduces herself as “Urakawa” is supposedly the Saint’s best friend—or so she says, but in reality, she’s Yui herself in disguise! Completely unaware of this, Bunta is given “100% accurate advice” directly from the person herself, all while being playfully teased. Will this advice help Bunta get closer to the Saint?
“Hehe, listen to my (the back’s) advice and make sure you properly conquer me (the front), okay?”
A romantic comedy where Bunta is tossed around by two personas of the same girl, each with a completely different personality!
associated_names: 裏ギャルちゃんのアドバイスは100%当たる 「だって君の好きな聖女様、私のことだからね」

91789.synopsis:
Ye Xin was living her life as a diligent office worker when, after a bike accident, she found herself transported to a time where food was scarce and had also gained a skinny fiancé.
The original owner of her body was a young, weak, and ill-natured “educated youth” sent to the countryside. She was not well-liked and was currently in a dispute with her fiancé over breaking off their engagement… Ye Xin felt troubled, thinking, “What a mess!”
But she couldn’t return to her old world, so she had no choice but to adapt and survive.
First of all, she decided to stop arguing—her fiancé was handsome, hardworking, and quite capable. Secondly, she would use her golden finger (a mysterious power) to grow crops, earn food, and take good care of herself, while also helping her fiancé out. She was sixteen, he was seventeen, and they would eat their fill, grow taller, and their future would be full of possibilities.
Farm work in the countryside was tough. During the day, she was busy, and at night, the space she had access to was even busier. There was no way she could finish all the farming work. But the harvests were always rewarding: rice, vegetables, fruits, meat, eggs—more than they could ever eat.
The only thing she wasn’t happy about was that while she had only grown a few centimeters, her fiancé kept growing taller and more handsome… He was almost at the level of a male model! And the way he looked at her became less and less restrained.
“We’ve grown up, shouldn’t we get married now?” “I think… I can still grow a bit more…”
The once quiet, weak young man was now tall and strong, still cold in public, but when alone, he would bend down and gently coax his fiancé.
associated_names: 七零之好好种田养自己

92301.synopsis:
Ryoma Kogure, a high school student, is surprised when his childhood friend and best friend, Hirasawa Reo, who has always been popular yet indifferent to romance, suddenly confides in him about a love matter.
However, when Ryouma learns that Reo’s crush is their quiet classmate, Otsuki Shizuku, he decides to help him out.
While personally gathering information on Shizuku for his best friend, Ryoma is unexpectedly summoned by the school’s most beautiful girl, Asahina Alisa!
She, being Shizuku’s best friend, mistakenly believes that Ryouma has feelings for Shizuku…!?
Caught in Alisa’s misunderstanding, Ryoma scrambles to sort things out…
As they began supporting their best friends for their own reason, Ryoma and Alisa grow closer——
A romantic comedy that starts with friends supporting each other’s love!
associated_names: Gakkou Ichi no Bishoujo to Shinyuu Doushi no Renai Soudan ni Notte Itara, Itsunomanika Kanojo ga Dare Yori mo Chikai Sonzai ni Natteta Ken
学校一の美少女と親友同士の恋愛相談に乗っていたら、いつのまにか彼女が誰よりも近い存在になってた件

93581.synopsis:
Due to an unexpected twist of fate, college student Luo Yu finds himself in a world that’s intense beyond belief—
Here, people have completely eradicated sleep by taking potions, working 24/7!
Baffled, Luo Yu tries to nap on his desk, only to be mistaken as unconscious by his never-slept-in-their-life roommates and rushed to the hospital…
In an effort to sleep without trouble, Luo Yu writes down “Promoting Classical Culture—Sleeping” on his streaming platform. With the official title of “Sleep Broadcaster,” he goes live daily to sleep.
When the livestream starts, Luo Yu with a face mask on, classical music playing, and a soft cotton robe that he swaps for silk pajamas, he lights some sleep incense and nestles into a cozy bed.
After all this… the stream’s viewer count barely moves.
But when he wakes up, the number of viewers has shockingly hit six digits!
Luo Yu: “???” Why are so many people watching him sleep?
The comments evolve from “Is this guy crazy?” overnight to:
“My husband looks so lovely sleeping; I never knew sleep could be this fascinating.”
“That’s my husband! Look at those soft cheeks, mwah!”
“Licking the screen, licking the screen…”
2.
Under the impact of Luo Yu’s “sleeping beauty” charm, a sleep revival trend sweeps the globe!
After hearing reports from his subordinates, Professor Song Lingyuan, head of the International Progress Association and a young genius, issues an order to permanently ban Luo Yu’s account on the grounds of “disrupting social order” and “hindering social progress.”
However, with secret support from underground groups considered rebellious by the Association, Luo Yu’s sleep livestream manages to make small comebacks!
Then it’s banned. Then it resurfaces!
Banned again. Then resurfaces again!
…
After the 9nth round of “sleep crackdowns,” Song Lingyuan sees another live notification pop up on his phone and, exasperated, angrily taps into the stream by mistake.
Then…
Looking grim but unable to look away, he watches for a long time.
Sends the most expensive “rocket” gift.
Accidentally becomes the top-ranking fan.
Subordinate, shocked: “Professor, you—”
Song Lingyuan calmly tosses the phone aside:
“It was an accident.”
“He’s stirring up the masses. Ban him for good!”
associated_names: 我靠直播睡觉爆红全球

95117.synopsis:
“Have you heard? A new demon has appeared in the Jianghu?”
“Are you talking about that Shi Laomo, the one who claims to have world-shaking wisdom?”
“Yes, that demon! He’s incredibly powerful in martial arts. He often uses a flawed manual to drive entire sects mad, turning them into something neither human nor ghost, completely insane! And he takes pleasure in it!”
“I’ve heard similar things! That demon is truly heartless and insane!”
Half a divine manual sets Shi Feizhe on his martial arts path!
When he finally becomes invincible, when everyone cries out to defeat him, facing the rumors of the Jianghu, he angrily rebukes:
“What? I practiced it wrong?”
“Impossible! Absolutely not!”
“With the same technique, I’m clearly stronger!”
“You can’t cultivate it? That’s because your talent is insufficient, it’s your problem! You are the ones who are wrong!”
“No one understands martial arts cultivation better than me!”
City of Yellow Heaven plunges readers into a world of high-stakes martial arts, treacherous alliances, and the relentless pursuit of power. 
Shi Feizhe, a transmigrator from a world of mundane office work, finds himself in Yiyang City, newly occupied by the enigmatic Yellow Heaven Path. 
Determined to forge a different destiny in this dangerous new reality, he stumbles upon a mysterious martial arts manual, the True Origin Sword Finger Formula, setting him on a path of self-discovery and perilous adventure.

96653.synopsis: I became the heroine of an NTR manga, where the genders are reversed, a childhood friend who is weak to threats.

97677.synopsis:
Elliot, who returned from the battlefield, obtained the holy sword and became a hero as a holy knight, presented his wife Flora with a divorce letter shortly after his return.
He told her that he had fallen in love with Emily, a woman who had been by his side on the battlefield and who had come to be known as a saint because of her deeds. Flora, who had lived in the safety of the royal capital and prayed every day, had lost her place to live.
Flora quietly accepted the divorce without any objections and disappeared from the royal capital.
From that day on, strange things began to happen around Elliot.
Meanwhile, Flora met some unusual people on her journey and learned about blessings.
associated_names: さよなら、英雄になった旦那様～ただ祈るだけの役立たずの妻のはずでしたが…～

97933.synopsis:
My closet is home to three spirit tablets and a statue.
A drowned ghost, an old female ghost from the Republic of China, the vengeful spirit of a foolish girl, and a dark statue of a child.
One loves sweets, another loves spicy food, one foolishly forces me to sleep with her every night, and the other tries every trick in the book to possess me.
They rule my house with an iron fist, demanding three incense sticks morning, noon, and night, not to mention an endless supply of snacks and sweets.
Looking at my dwindling allowance, I sighed deeply.
“It’s time to make some money!”
associated_names: Tiān tóng 4: Měng guǐ dà shà

101517.synopsis:
An inhuman race? Such a thing should not exist.
I respect everyone who practices human supremacism.
I wanted to be born as a human, too.
I hate that I am merely a human-like being.
They say my human blood is thicker, but…
The moment I have horns on my head, I am just something similar to a human.
associated_names: I Am A Tool of Humanity

102029.synopsis:
Qiao Xi’s luck wasn’t like others who transmigrated into extraordinary adventures; instead, he ended up farming every day. After years of studying hard to escape the mountains and earn a decent living, he suddenly found himself poor again due to his transmigration, leaving him cursing his situation daily.
One day, he stumbles upon a dirty, unconscious man in the mountains and decides to bring him home. After cleaning him up, Qiao Xi discovers the man is surprisingly handsome and muscular, so he keeps him as free labor to farm and make a living together. Little did he expect that the man came with a small child in tow, and their lives grew increasingly harmonious—until one thing led to another, and Qiao Xi ended up in bed with his muscular helper. Ever the self-proclaimed straight man, Qiao Xi brushes it off as a purely platonic arrangement… until his belly starts to grow. When the village chief’s wife gleefully informs him he’s expecting, Qiao Xi is so shocked he faints on the spot.
Shen Yiguang, meanwhile, was once a general from a prestigious noble family, famed for his military achievements. At just 14, he was named a General of Courage and entrusted with the emperor’s dying wish to protect the young crown prince and secure the throne from the treacherous third prince. Injured during an ambush while fleeing with the prince, Shen Yiguang barely escapes death and collapses in the wilderness. When he awakens, the first thing he sees is a beautiful man taking care of him.
In order to stay in Tao Ye Village and hide from pursuit, Shen Yiguang decides to earn Qiao Xi’s trust and deliberately seduces this rough villager, whom he had originally looked down on. He shows off his muscles and demonstrates his skills in front of his wife every day, skillfully settling himself in the village.
A year later, Shen Yiguang triumphantly leads his army back to the capital, restoring the young prince to the throne and reclaiming his status. However, when he looks back, he realizes his beautiful “wife” has run away! Panicked and no longer in denial about his feelings, the proud general floods the city with posters to find Qiao Xi, while the young crown prince issues a bounty of gold to assist in the search.

103565.synopsis: Even if I don’t want to, even if my whole body rejects it, I am the main heroine of this novel.

105101.synopsis: Emperors and generals, great deeds; wise men and migrants, immortal articles; beautiful women and luxurious cars, heroic spirit… I only ask one question: Can I achieve immortality? This is a story about traveling through the ancient times of the Dharma Ending Age to seek immortality. Time flies, years pass by; the corpse is transformed into a fairy, and immortality remains in the world.

106381.synopsis:
The reality show ‘Actor: Inescapable Justice’ has taken the nation by storm, drawing millions of viewers. The production team selects top-tier actors to portray criminals in each episode, crafting intense and thrilling crime scenarios.
Episode 1: Zhang Songwen plays a drug dealer tasked with selling three kilograms of “flour,” but he’s caught before finishing the job.
Episode 2: Wang Baoqiang takes on the role of a midnight serial killer, aiming for three consecutive mu*ders, but he falls into the investigation team’s trap and gets arrested.
No matter how skilled the actors are, justice always prevails.
That is until Chen Shu accidentally stumbles onto the set.
Bringing advanced crime techniques from past-life movies, he reenacts strategies from Sheep Without a Shepherd, Detective Chinatown, Wrath of Silence, and The Long Night…
His intricate plans and near-flawless execution leave audiences in awe.
Even Wang Zheng, the head of the Criminal Investigation Unit, admits, “Thank goodness Chen Shu isn’t a real criminal. If he were, his perfect crimes would be impossible to solve!”

109197.synopsis:
I got transmigrated into a game I hadn’t touched in ages as a third-rate villain in a magic academy with Magic Power: 1.

111501.synopsis:
Xu Yitong had a c*cky and pretentious younger cousin. Later, her cousin went pro in esports and “accidentally” provoked a famous player. Unfortunately, this player wasn’t easy to mess with, and his fans were even fiercer. Her cousin was chased all over the internet, thoroughly flamed and roasted.
Xu Yitong sighed, “What kind of people like him? Don’t they have enough homework to do?”
…
Later that night, Xu Yitong messaged her cousin:
[You’ll laugh, but it turns out I’m the kind of person who likes him : ) ] 
[Don’t piss off my husband again, okay?] 
“My preference for you is reflected in how I hate everything mint-related, yet you are my only Little Fish Mint.”
Chatty Young Miss x Cold Aloof King
Tags: Love at First Sight, Lighthearted
Main Characters: Xu Yitong, Yu Ge
Other: Chatty Young Miss x Cold Aloof King
One-sentence Summary: And you are my only Little Fish Mint
Theme: You will always be my one and only

112525.synopsis:
[No harem, no cliches, no overpowered protagonist, no systems, no brainless plot, no wish-fulfillment story—proceed with caution if any of these are your preferences.] 
Du Yu, who dies an untimely death at the very start of the story, begins working for the Legend Management Bureau in hopes of earning a better spot in his next reincarnation. His job is to travel into various distorted legends and guide their plots back on track.
Unexpectedly, Du Yu—a mere mortal—is immediately assigned a top-tier difficulty mission: the legend of “Hou Yi Shooting Down the Nine Suns.”
In this version of the tale, Hou Yi is just an ordinary man. As a fellow mortal, how is Du Yu supposed to help another mortal shoot down nine suns…?

113037.synopsis:
[Fantasy, Comedy, Invincible, Misunderstanding, System, Reincarnation] 
“I trusted you as my system, and you tricked me for a hundred years! So I’m not actually a weakling?!” 
Finally, one day, Lin Qi discovered that he was no mere pushover and burst into tears. Thus, under the guidance of the ‘Silly Four’’, he emerged from seclusion.
But soon, Lin Qi began to notice something amiss. 
Huh? What? 
I just wanted to make some money and eat a pork knuckle rice meal—how did I end up in a war? 
What? 
I’m supposed to rule the world? 
Since when?! 
Eh? 
There are gods in this world?!
“Dear gods, please hear me out! I never intended to dethrone you all!”
associated_names: 我，无敌强者，被系统骗了一百年

113549.synopsis:
Blunt General x Little Blind Low-Rank Incubus
[ Rebirth + Pure Sweetness] 
In his past life, Jiang Chuang married a blind prince. The two shared a period of deep affection.
But after being betrayed by Wen Jue, Jiang Chuang was left devastated—their hearts grew distant.
To him, Wen Jue was nothing more than a deceiver wrapped in a gentle, harmless facade.
He played with Jiang Chuang’s emotions, had him wrapped around his finger, and nearly caused Jiang Chuang’s closest friend to fall into a place of no return.
And yet, in the end, it was Wen Jue who took an arrow for him.
Barely breathing, he lay dying in Jiang Chuang’s arms, apologizing, tearing off his mask, and pleading:
“Can you stop being mad at me… husband?”
Before Jiang Chuang could say “yes,” Wen Jue stopped breathing—his hollow eyes turned lifeless.
In the end, Jiang Chuang held him and jumped off a cliff.
Back in this life, Jiang Chuang has only one thought: Wen Jue.
And watching him quietly perform…
Watching how he exhausts every trick, pretending innocence, hiding his true self, and bending over backward to please Jiang Chuang.
Then, slowly—tearing through his facade.
Watching the darkness and twists, the carefully laid schemes, the venomous heart.
And letting him know—Jiang Chuang loves every version of him, as long as it’s him.
P.S.: There’s just a tiny bit of court intrigue~ The author’s a total newbie when it comes to scheming, so please don’t be too harsh, okay? This story is all about the romance!

One day, the penniless and down-on-his-luck Huai Shi suddenly discovered that the cheat-like ability he picked up could finally be used…
Unfortunately, this didn’t seem to be a good thing.
In order to make money and stay alive, he accidentally set foot into this dangerous world.
The Border beyond Reality, the Anomaly behind Everyday Life.
The Astronomical Society, Green Sun, Golden Dawn, the Remnants of the Lost World, and the Nemeses of All Realms…
Survival or destruction?
That is the question.

117389.synopsis:
My name is Ye Xuan.
I’m a transmigrator, and I’ve spent eighteen years surviving in a xuanhuan world.
For eighteen years, I cultivated like my life depended on it—because it did.
At three, I opened my Qi Sea.
At five, I awakened my Divine Bone.
At sixteen, I became the youngest direct disciple of the Xuantian Sect.
Now, with the sect’s life-and-death trial only a month away, everything is going according to plan. Once I pass it, I’ll become the next heir of the Xuantian Sect.
My future is limitless.
Then a letter from home arrives.
Apparently, in some backwater city, I have a fiancée I’ve never met. Once a clan genius, she lost all her cultivation overnight and became a complete waste in everyone’s eyes.
Her family wants me to hurry over and break off the engagement.
Oh, and there’s one more thing—
she wears a mysterious ring on her finger.
…Wait.
A fallen genius?
A broken engagement?
A mysterious ring?
After eighteen years of desperate cultivation, don’t tell me—
I’m the villain in the protagonist’s backstory?!

119437.synopsis:
Overworked to the point of collapse, he passes out and wakes up with memories of his past life—and a system.
He was supposed to have a bright and promising future, but… why is life even harder now?
If he slacks off in class, the system will randomly send a confession text to a girl!

119693.synopsis: Alphas, vastly superior in every aspect, sought to pass down wealth and power to their alpha offspring to solidify their status. However, omegas, capable of bearing alpha children, made up only about 5% of the population, their scarcity and value exceptionally high. Consequently, most alphas did not form pairs outside their lineage, instead bonding with omegas within their family to continue their legacy. This practice, known as the “shared ownership of kin omegas” in alpha families, has come to be accepted as entirely natural in the present day.

119949.synopsis:
A bloody catastrophe shattered a thousand-year-old dynasty. As the sole surviving prince, a Transmigrator, Li Yuan fled in disguise to the Southern Border, where he joined the Gu Master lineage and awakened the Gu Insect Fusion System.
Outside, various warlords, demons, monsters, and martial sects were all hunting him down, hoping to use his royal blood as the key to unlock the Martial God’s Treasure left behind by the founding emperor.
Martial God’s Treasure? I am clearly destined for Gu!
Li Yuan chose to lie low and refine Gu.
【Added Longevity Grass – You’ve synthesized the Rebirth Gu】
【Added Sands of Time – You’ve synthesized the Everchanging Gu】
【Added the Empress’s Blood – You’ve synthesized the Imperial Majesty Gu】
…
Thirty long years passed.
The invincible Martial Emperor, the overlord of demons and monsters across the seas, and the power-hungry warlords finally found Li Yuan.
I finally embarked on the journey to win a battle once deemed lost.
I am the Gu Immortal!
And I also happen to be the Martial God!
associated_names: 南疆炼蛊三十载，世人敬我如敬神

131725.synopsis:
The Ninth Lady of the Marquis of Kaiping’s household, Lang Jiuchuan, returned to the capital after spending more than ten years away recuperating, only to attend a funeral. Yet, upon reunion, her birth mother disliked her, her family distanced themselves, and she was regarded as nothing but a troublemaker and a jinx.
Entering the capital’s noble circle for the first time, the aristocrats mocked her as a country bumpkin with the face of someone destined for an early death, her manners crude, like wild grass from the mountains—utterly unfit for the grand stage.
But Lang Jiuchuan thought: wild grass is the best! Full of life, growing tall with the wind—it resonated with her heart completely!
While people secretly placed bets on when this seemingly insignificant, short-lived girl would perish, they forgot—she was a “calamity,” one that could last a thousand years.
That’s right, she might look delicate, soft, and easy to bully, but—just try and touch her.
Do they sigh that she has no one to protect her? What a joke. She can grow her own wings—why bother climbing anyone else’s ladder?
By day she severs the yang, by night she severs the yin. With divine powers that shook the world, nobles knelt with riches, begging to invite her aid. Yet all Lang Jiuchuan wanted was to accumulate merit, reshape her body, extend her life, recover her soul—and settle old scores along the way.
